Tutorials

Learn one action, then use it on the road.

TURN TUTORIAL

One lap of COUNTRYSIDE in the LEARNER CAR. Lessons pause the game; hold the highlighted control to continue. Optional steering help takes care of bends while you learn the drive pad.

DRIFT ATTACK & FLOW

Both use CLIFFSIDE in the LEARNER CAR after their mechanics unlock. DRIFT ATTACK teaches scoring, linked slides and OVERCHARGE. FLOW teaches varied techniques and COMBO.

DRIVE BY EAR TUTORIAL

Five parts in the TRACTOR: find the ribbon, listen ahead, leave and return, trust the sequence, then drive by ear. Each part gives you room to learn the sound language.

Return whenever you want

Open HOW TO PLAY → TUTORIALS. Skipping turns off reminders rather than completing the tutorial. RESTART LAP also resets an active tutorial. Tutorial laps keep their learning rewards separate from ordinary achievement farming.
